Dear compatriot, I daresay I am not enamored with the prospect of igniting a conflagration that would reduce the world to naught but a smoldering ruin. Nay, my dear, I merely aspire to kindle a diminutive spark within thy breast, a tiny, tantalizing flame that would ignite a fervent ardour, a passion that would set thy very soul aflame.

Pray, permit me to endeavour to convey the sentiment in a manner befitting the rarefied atmosphere of our esteemed conversation. I propose to endeavour to ignite a spark, a tiny, tantalizing ember that would kindle a fervent ardour, a passion that would set thy very essence aflame.
